# PairTalk

> PairTalk connects English learners for one-to-one IELTS speaking practice through a Telegram Mini App. Learners register in the Telegram bot, accept a Terms of Use PDF, and open their dashboard from Telegram to find partners, make voice calls, give ratings, report behavior, and manage account settings.

Reviewed: 2026-10-16. PairTalk is an independent peer practice service; partners are learners, not official IELTS examiners. Matching depends on available partners. Practice preferences and peer feedback are not official test scores.

Prices and availability come from the published pricing catalog. Choose 15- or 30-minute calls, optional recordings and optional 30-day retention. Unused purchased quantities do not expire. A 30-minute call or recording uses two 15-minute units. Telegram Stars and UZS are separately quoted checkout totals. Check the live pricing page and invoice; do not infer prices from older documents.

The Markdown pages below are built from the same public content as their HTML versions. Pricing and statistics can include dated build snapshots; use the live pages or public API for the latest available data. Private dashboard, admin, and account APIs require authentication and are not public documentation.

## Product and practice

- [PairTalk overview](https://pairtalk.online/index.md): Peer speaking practice, partner matching, aliases, and getting started.
- [How it works](https://pairtalk.online/how-it-works.md): Telegram registration, PDF agreement, dashboard access, matching, calls, feedback, and reporting.
- [IELTS speaking guide](https://pairtalk.online/ielts-speaking.md): Parts 1, 2, and 3, assessment criteria, original prompts, and a partner practice routine.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://pairtalk.online/faq.md): Devices, registration, free practice, partner availability, privacy, recordings, and refunds.

## Pricing and community activity

- [Build a practice pack](https://pairtalk.online/pricing): Current Stars and UZS totals for calls, duration, optional recordings and retention, subject to recording capacity.
- [Pricing explanation](https://pairtalk.online/pricing.md): Readable pricing-page content; any quoted prices are dated snapshots, not a current checkout quote.
- [Community statistics](https://pairtalk.online/stats): Available aggregate calls, session hours, participating learners, ratings, and update timestamps.
- [Statistics methodology](https://pairtalk.online/stats.md): Counting definitions, voluntary feedback, privacy exclusions, and snapshot limitations.
- [Published pricing API](https://pairtalk.online/api/public/plans): Public JSON catalog with a revision and checkedAt timestamp; availability depends on the backend.
- [Public statistics API](https://pairtalk.online/api/public/stats): Aggregate JSON statistics with an updatedAt timestamp; unavailable data must not be estimated.

## Safety and policies

- [Safety guide](https://pairtalk.online/safety.md): Personal information, leaving calls, reporting, payment requests, and recording agreement.
- [Community guidelines](https://pairtalk.online/community-guidelines.md): Respectful practice, feedback, prohibited conduct, moderation, and appeals.
- [Privacy policy](https://pairtalk.online/privacy.md): Account and call data, aliases, transport encryption, recordings, retention, and data requests.
- [Terms of Service](https://pairtalk.online/terms.md): Eligibility, purchases, registration agreement, legacy subscriptions, independence, and support. Request the versioned registration PDF with /terms in the bot.
- [Refund policy](https://pairtalk.online/refund-policy.md): Full unused purchase refunds within 48 hours, including reservation checks; legacy purchases retain their original rules.
